scope: Visible reference check on twelve physically distinct ordinary target observations, four per platform
selection: Fixed raw-text screen and a SHA-256 ordering with recording round-robin from the registered panel. No prediction, IoU, or annotation affects which observations are selected.
review: One reader reviews the original wording and visible context with numbered dataset-annotated boxes. Model predictions are hidden. Ambiguous, missing and unresolvable IDs are kept as UNKNOWN.
score: For a verified reference label use strict oriented IoU > 0.25 for each endpoint. Count both source directions but report physical observations. Unknowns stay in the panel accounting.
purpose: Small descriptive check of real natural reference identities after all model outputs are sealed
